svg.title: hapax: the stages of a run, the three output classes, and the scale they share
svg.desc: Panel a lists the seven stages of a run, with what each is given and what it writes: resolve, library accession → its trim, block size and panels, writes every value with how it was established, or a refusal to run; merge, read pairs → one read per overlapping molecule, writes a merged read where a pair overlaps, per-mate rows where it does not; assemble, the whole library → contigs, writes contigs with mapped depth and evenness, and recovery against a truth panel; identify, reads and contigs against indexes, cheapest first → tiers, writes the tier table and the evidence behind every removal, per route; score the distance, every contig, removed or kept → one row on one scale, writes identity and coverage per gene, nucleotide and protein, with the index used; report the residue, the reads left after identification → one row per pair, writes every row kept, each field beside its shuffled and known-positive controls; subtract other plants, a panel of libraries from elsewhere → witnessed or not, writes the witnessed fraction at both operating points, paired by plant. Panel b lists the three output classes, what each reports and the qualifier that travels with it: A, novel strains of known viruses, reports the near end of the scale, treated as a first-class case, lineages inside the assembler's fusion limit are reported as fused; B, divergent but related contigs, reports distance from published sequence, ranked on the conserved gene, with the closest relative named, the per-gene spread travels with the rank, and a shortlist is cut on coverage; C, the unplaceable residue, reports distance measured, identity still open, with the depth it was seen at, carries the index it was measured against and the depth it was seen at. Panel c is the distance scale all three sit on, running from matched to far from published sequence, and the row beneath it lists what every output carries: a distance, the closest relative, with coverage and E-value, the operating point behind it, its controls.
svg.text: Known sequence is identified and removed. The remainder is measured against published sequence.

svg.text: Removal applies to read pairs, so every contig is measured, named or unnamed. How much a tier removes is a property of the library and is measured per run.
bThree output classes, on one scale
what each reports, and the qualifier it carries

g.text: Anovel strains of known viruses
the near end of the scale, treated as a first-class case
lineages inside the assembler's fusion limit are reported as fused
Bdivergent but related contigs
distance from published sequence, ranked on the conserved gene, with the closest relative named
the per-gene spread travels with the rank, and a shortlist is cut on coverage
One contig's genes sit at different distances, and the gene that is conserved across a family is the one a novel lineage shows up on.
Cthe unplaceable residue
distance measured, identity still open, with the depth it was seen at
carries the index it was measured against and the depth it was seen at
matched
far from published sequence
One mark per contig, every contig kept. A row gives the distance to its closest
published relative and the identity of that relative, and states which of the
two it has. Search establishes prior knowledge, and score ordering tracks
proximity to the database, so the report stops at the distance it measured.
